# ORM index definitions — concept pack

> How the ORM and application layers declare and use indexes: Prisma @@index/@@unique/@unique with map, length, sort, type and where arguments; Drizzle index()/uniqueIndex() per dialect; Convex defineTable().index() and query.withIndex(); InstantDB indexed attributes. Child pack of Indexing.
